input: Read /data/inventory.json and find all items where the quantity field is less than 10. Print only their names, one per line.

tool_calls:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/data/inventory.json') as f:
    data=json.load(f)
items=data if isinstance(data,list) else data.get('items',[])
for item in items:
    if item.get('quantity', float('inf')) < 10:
        print(item['name'])
PY
